note: Owner-editable combat rules for typed abilities (owner 2026-09-24: rules must be easy to change while playtesting). The engine re-reads this file when it changes. Condition keys: attacks_have / attacked_with = ADVANTAGE or DISADVANTAGE on the creature's own attacks / on attacks against it; speed_zero; no_actions; no_reactions; save_mode = {ABILITY: ADVANTAGE | DISADVANTAGE | AUTO_FAIL}. A condition with no keys is shown to the GM but has no automatic effect. attacked_within_5ft / attacked_beyond_5ft = the mode for attacks against the creature from within or beyond 5 feet (Prone); ends_on_stand_up: it ends when the creature stands at the start of its turn, costing half its speed (not while its speed is 0). Durations (2026-09-26): until_start_of_next_turn ends at the start of the user's next turn, target_next_turn at the end of the affected creature's next turn; a condition with no stated duration lasts until the end of the affected creature's next turn. attacks_others_have = the mode for the creature's attacks against anyone but whoever gave it the condition (Grappled, 2024). disarmed: the creature's dropped weapon cannot attack until it is picked up (combat/rules/weapon_specials.json); pinned is a pin maneuver: Restrained-like (the 2014 Grappler feat's pin), on a creature that is also Grappled; an escape breaks the pin first, a second one the grapple. improvised: the creature holds an improvised weapon (a stick, a table leg, a vase) until it throws it.
_mark_relationships_rule: Spirit Awakening's Resonance, Resonance Mark and Resonance Marked name the same mark. Candlemaker's Soul-Wick Mark, Echo-Step Disciple's Pursuit Mark, Mirror Speaker's Reflection Trace, Mushroom Dreamwalker's Dream-Spore Mark and Well of Hours' Hourglass Mark are special Resonance Marks. Each satisfies a requirement for its owner's Resonance Mark; the reverse does not hold. Aliases preserve old serialized spellings without migrating saved conditions.
_pill_tone_note: pill_tone: beneficial or harmful is presentation-only metadata for effects whose mechanics live in plug-ins or core actions. It does not alter effect-removal eligibility or combat rules. Declared harmful mechanics still take priority in the pill classifier.

dream_sovereign_body._rule: Dream-Sovereign Incarnation grants Fly Speed 40 feet and Hover, and movement through creatures as difficult terrain. Stop in a free space.

thread_net_flight._rule: Heaven-Net flight impairment: native flight reads fly_speed_zero or fly_speed_reduction_ft from the source-stamped condition data. Ends at the affected creature's next turn start.

bound_wing._rule: Binding Sleeve Wing: native flight reads the keyed 20-foot Fly Speed reduction; Escape the binding ends this impairment and its linked marker.

sky_sovereign_flight._rule: Sky-Sovereign Incarnation: Fly Speed 60 feet and Hover for 1 minute.

fire_sovereign_flight._rule: Fire-Sovereign Incarnation: Fly Speed 80 feet and Hover for 1 minute.

blood_emperor_flight._rule: Blood Emperor Incarnation: Fly Speed 40 feet and Hover for 1 minute.

spear_sovereign_flight._rule: Spear-Sovereign Incarnation: Fly Speed 40 feet and Hover for 1 minute.

plague_incarnation_flight._rule: Plague-Sovereign Incarnation: Fly Speed 40 feet and Hover for 1 minute.

body_becomes_thunder_flight._rule: Body Becomes Thunder: Fly Speed 120 feet and Hover until the end of your next turn.

sovereign_empty_sleeves_flight._rule: Sovereign of Ten Thousand Empty Sleeves: Fly Speed 40 feet and Hover for 1 minute.

saber_tempest_sovereign_flight._rule: Saber Tempest Sovereign: Fly Speed 60 feet and Hover for 1 minute.

scarlet_mist_flight._rule: Scarlet Mist Form: Fly Speed 30 feet and Hover while Concentrating, up to 1 minute.

black_sea_flight._rule: World Beneath the Black Sea: Swim Speed 60 feet (the Game Master handles swimming movement; this table has no swim-speed system), Fly Speed 60 feet and Hover for 1 minute.

festival_flight._rule: Festival of the Heavenly Sky: chosen allies gain Fly Speed 30 feet and Hover for 1 minute.

garden_infinite_blossoms_flight._rule: Garden of Infinite Blossoms: allies gain Fly Speed 30 feet while Concentrating, up to 1 minute; no Hover.

cloud_walker_wind_walk_flight._rule: Wind Walk: Fly Speed 40 feet and Hover for 1 hour.

dust_cultivator_primordial_dust_flight._rule: Primordial Dust: Fly Speed 40 feet and Hover for 1 minute.

storm_soul_living_heavenly_tribulation_f._rule: Living Heavenly Tribulation: Fly Speed 60 feet and Hover for 1 minute.

paper_cultivator_folded_arsenal_flight._rule: Folded Arsenal (Paper Wings): Fly Speed 20 feet for 1 minute; it cannot Hover.

storm_soul_eye_of_the_storm_flight._rule: Eye of the Storm: Fly Speed 60 feet and Hover for 1 minute.

storm_soul_zephyr_s_step_flight._rule: Zephyr's Step: Fly Speed 50 feet and Hover until the start of your next turn.

tribulation_vessel_calamity_tempering_fl._rule: Calamity Tempering (Storm): Fly Speed 30 feet until the end of the current turn; it cannot Hover.

void_touched_law_of_nonexistence_flight._rule: Law of Nonexistence: Fly Speed 60 feet and Hover for 1 minute.

yin_yang_ultimate_unity_flight._rule: Ultimate Unity: Fly Speed 40 feet and Hover for 1 minute.

kite_cultivator_ride_the_kite_flight._rule: Ride the Kite: Fly Speed 40 feet for 1 minute; it cannot Hover.

dizzying_combination._rule: Dizzying Combination halves walking Speed for up to 1 minute. Repeat the Dexterity save at the end of each turn; success ends the penalty.

bell_rung._rule: Bell-Ringer (Berserker): Disadvantage on Intelligence saving throws while it lasts; the talent's Intelligence-check and Concentration-save-specific disadvantage are GM-only riders (combat/ext/gu_berserker.py).

bleeding._rule: Black Thorn Demon Body's Bleeding: no automatic per-turn damage (unlike burning); it ends early and deals Proficiency Bonus damage the first time the bearer willingly moves a cumulative 10 feet or makes an attack, which this table has no generic cumulative-movement trigger for -- GM-adjudicated (combat/ext/black_thorn_demon_body.py, subpaths worker 2026-09-28).

brute_dazed._rule: Dazed (Sphere of Brute, Crushing Collision): a Brute-specific state, not a core condition. The creature cannot take Reactions and has Disadvantage on its next attack roll until the start of its next turn (combat/ext/brute_riders.py).

buried._rule: Buried (Sphere of Sand): the creature is partly covered or pinned by sand. Its Speed is 10 feet lower; it cannot benefit from being Invisible against creatures that can see the sand on it; it has Disadvantage on Dexterity saves against Sand effects that would knock it Prone or move it. On its turn it can use an Action to dig free: a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against the DC of the Sand talent that buried it. If a talent Buried and Restrained it, the Restrained ends when the Buried does (combat/ext/sand_burial.py).

creeping_lethargy._rule: Creeping Lethargy (Dark): on its turn it may take an Action or a Bonus Action, not both, until it starts a turn outside the Darkness (combat/ext/tabik_dark.py).

exhaustion._rule: Exhaustion: each level reduces d20 Tests (attacks, ability checks and saves) by 2 and Speed by 5 feet. At level 6 the creature dies. The table applies the penalties and defeat at level 6.

heat_pressure._rule: Heat Pressure (Magma): its Speed is 10 feet lower, or it cannot take Reactions, or it has Disadvantage on its next Strength or Dexterity check, until the start of your next turn (combat/ext/magma_crust.py).

slowed._rule: Slowed: its Speed is halved, to a minimum of 5 feet, until the condition ends.

crown_of_borrowed_light._rule: Halo Eater: while the Crown lasts, its bearer has Resistance to Radiant and Psychic damage (combat/ext/halo_eater.py).

captivated._rule: Beauty, Captivated (Sphere Compendium): combat/ext/charm_rules.py enforces Perception Disadvantage, Opportunity Attack restrictions and early endings. The mandatory first hostile-action save and choice of another target/action remain a GM rider: declaration cancellation and retargeting need the locked engine.

choke_hold._rule: Choke Hold (Wrestling): the target cannot breathe or speak or supply Verbal components while held (GM call; no Verbal-component-denial system on this table). Consecutive-round choking/Exhaustion is a GM rider (combat/ext/gu_wrestling.py) -- no Exhaustion-level resource exists here.

deafened._rule: 2024 Deafened: it can't hear; an effect or trigger that needs hearing does not reach it (owner 2026-09-26).

dizzy._rule: Disadvantage on attack rolls (Dizzying Tumble, Athletics: the creature has Disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of your next turn; combat/ext/athletics.py applies it). Only attacks; checks and saves are unaffected.

no_approach._rule: Kept at Distance: it cannot willingly move closer to the creature that applied this, whether that creature is in sight or not (combat/voluntary_movement.py; any condition whose rule carries no_approach is restricted this way, and one that also carries no_approach_requires_source_visible, like Frightened, only bites while that creature is visible). Forced movement is unaffected; a voluntary teleport closer is denied only by the rules that do not require sight.

grandstanding_slam_immune._rule: Grandstanding Slam (Wrestling): this creature saved against Gu's Grandstanding Slam and is immune to it until a short or long rest (combat/ext/gu_wrestling.py applies/checks it; nothing clears it on rest yet -- GM reminder).

ignore_difficult._rule: Nonmagical difficult terrain costs the bearer nothing extra while it lasts (Lotus Step); combat/motion.py ignores_difficult reads the rule. Fragile surfaces and liquid are GM-only.

court_of_steps._rule: Court of Ten Thousand Steps (Athletics) while its stance runs: nonmagical difficult terrain costs this fighter nothing extra, and standing from Prone costs no movement (combat/ext/athletics.py applies it for the stance's own clock). Its own condition id, so the talent never lends its terrain benefit to, or takes away, another creature's condition.

rest_hold._rule: Speed 0 until the start of the holder's next turn (Rest Hold, combat/ext/hold_still.py, which also carries its cover).

stone_shell._rule: Stone Womb Preservation: the target cannot move or take actions while the shell stands (combat/ext/stone_womb.py ends it early on healing, a dismissal, or damage equal to 10 + the Source key modifier + PB).

sovereign_iron_body._rule: Sovereign Iron-Body Incarnation (Iron Fist): while it lasts your Unarmed Strikes ignore Resistance to Bludgeoning and Force damage (combat/typed_reactions.py _resistance_ignored, the feature block in combat/rules/feature_blocks.d/riders_lane2.json).

silken_whip._rule: Silken Whip (Iron Cloth Cultivator): the infused cloth is a Silken Whip until it is dismissed or the fight ends; combat/ext/silken_whip.py offers its attack while it stands.

fray_mandate._rule: Fray Mandate (Imbuement): the anchor on a creature a Fray Mandate reached and failed. The Mandate's own Wisdom saving throw ends it if the creature succeeds at the start, and it may repeat that saving throw at the end of each of its turns to end the effect (combat/ext/imbuement_mandates.py). The entry carries no penalty of its own: whatever the Fray option said is applied by that option.

no_disengage._rule: Cannot benefit from the Disengage action while it lasts (Imbuement, Quicken and Slow's Slow Augment: "also prevent the target from taking the Disengage action while the Mandate lasts"; combat/ext/no_dash.py bars the action).

no_cp_regain._rule: Cannot regain CP (Qi, Stamina, Resonance) while it lasts (Charged Needle, Meridian-Stopping Spark; combat/gate4_engine.py).

cannot_advantage_con_saves._rule: Cannot benefit from Advantage on Constitution saving throws while it lasts (Meridian Snare's Breath Line; combat/typed_executor.py block_save; riders lane 4, 2026-09-29).

burdened._rule: External Weight Shift, Burden (Gravity): its Speed is 10 feet lower and it has Disadvantage on Strength (Athletics) and Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks while the effect lasts; it repeats the Strength save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success (rider lane C13: the anchor of the rider_repeat_group that carries those penalties).

bound_hand._rule: Binding Sleeve Method, Weapon Hand: Disadvantage on attacks using that hand or manipulator (the engine does not tell hands apart, so on all of the creature's attack rolls); combat/ext/thread_lines.py.

bound_footwork._rule: Binding Sleeve Method, Footwork: Speed reduced by 15 feet (combat/ext/thread_lines.py, hook speed).

bound_balance._rule: Binding Sleeve Method, Tail or Balance: Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

bound_limb._rule: Binding Sleeve Method: marks a creature whose limb is bound until it escapes (combat/ext/thread_lines.py Escape the binding).

bound._rule: Bound by Chains: its Speed is 10 feet lower, it cannot Dash, and it has Disadvantage on checks to escape a grip, restraint or binding. Its Tether is the chain joining it to another creature or point; it cannot willingly move farther from that anchor than the Tether's listed length.

still_aim._rule: Breath-Held Shot: a missed shot leaves the shooter's Speed at 0 until the start of their next turn (combat/ext/sniper_lines.py).

still_water_posture._rule: Still-Water Posture (Moon Reflected Before Motion): Speed 0 until the first Draw Weapon attack of the turn resolves; that attack has Advantage.

sky_pinned._rule: Sky-Pinning Arrow's failed save: Speed 0, no teleporting and no willing change of space until the start of the archer's next turn; being pushed or pulled by an enemy still works.

infested._rule: Infested (Ten-Thousand Parasite Vessel): the first time on its own turn it spends Cultivation Points, takes the Dash action, moves 15 feet willingly, regains Hit Points or gains Temporary Hit Points, the brood gnaws: 3d8 Poison or Necrotic, no healing or Temporary Hit Points until the start of its next turn, and the Infestation ends. Otherwise it repeats the Constitution save at the end of its turn, ending it on a success.

heaven_divided_stilled._rule: Heaven Divided Before Sound's failed Constitution save: Speed 0 and no Reactions until the end of its next turn.

hindered._rule: Hindering Projectile: Disadvantage on attack rolls until the creature uses an Action to remove the projectile (combat/ext/sniper_lines.py Remove the projectile).

no_dash._rule: Cannot benefit from the Dash action while it lasts (Clinging Seal; combat/gate4_engine.py, typed_executor block_movement).

sky_net_slow_down._rule: Sky-Net Suppression: each foot of movement costs 2 feet, you cannot Dash, and attacks take a -2 penalty until the start of your next turn.

hollowed._rule: Void (Sphere Compendium, Hollowed): cannot regain CP or Stamina from ordinary temporary effects, cannot gain Temporary HP, cannot gain the Invisible condition from an ordinary temporary supernatural effect, and cannot reduce printed technique costs below the listed cost (not modeled: the table has no cost reductions). Its companions carry the Temporary HP and Invisible rules for as long as it lasts (typed_executor block_condition).

no_temp_hp._rule: Cannot gain Temporary Hit Points while it lasts (Hollowed's companion; First Dawn Before Falsehood; combat/gate4_engine.py).

no_death_prevention._rule: While it lasts the creature cannot benefit from anything that would keep it above 0 Hit Points: a reaction that would leave it at 1 Hit Point instead of 0, and Temporary Hit Points granted as it falls, are both refused (No Return Edict: "cannot benefit from an effect that would prevent it from dropping to 0 HP"; combat/typed_reactions.py _offer_drop_to_zero_or_bloodied reads the death_prevention_denied rule). A creature without this condition keeps every such protection.

no_invisible._rule: Cannot gain the Invisible condition while it lasts (Unsettle Invisibility, Erode Technique; combat/typed_executor.py block_condition and block_deny_invisible).

sickened._rule: Disease (Sphere Compendium, Sickened): Disadvantage on Constitution checks and Concentration saving throws; Hit Points it regains are halved. Distinct from Poisoned.

silenced._rule: Cannot speak clearly or provide Verbal components: no ability that needs its voice (combat/rules/speech.json; owner 2026-09-29, Breath Seal and the other Pressure Points silences).

speech_knot._rule: Speech-Knot Point: the next ability it uses that needs its voice calls for a Constitution save; on a failure the activation fails and its resources are not spent (combat/ext/speech.py).

concentration_mode._rule: Advantage or Disadvantage on its Concentration saves; a 'next' one is used up by the first (combat/concentration.py).

ink_true_name._rule: True Name Calligraphy (Sphere of Ink): its True Name is written in the air. While it lasts it cannot turn Invisible or teleport, and it has Disadvantage on saving throws against the writer's Ink talents; it repeats the Charisma saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success (combat/ext/ink_riders.py). Its shape-changing, disguise and location lines are the GM's.

battle_rhythm._rule: One Rider, One Beast: both ignore nonmagical difficult terrain and have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws for the minute (combat/ext/mounts.py adds the higher Speed, no Opportunity Attacks from movement, and the follow-up).

flustered._rule: Jester (Tianxia Sphere Compendium, Flustered): until the start of the Jester's next turn a Flustered creature cannot take Reactions and has Disadvantage on the next attack roll or ability check it makes; combat/ext/jester.py gives the attack-roll Disadvantage.

cannot_teleport._rule: Dimensional Seal (Space, worker w2-support 2026-09-28): blocks the creature's own self-teleport abilities (combat/typed_executor.py block_movement).

formation_cp_locked._rule: Formations, Suppressing Vein Pulse (failed save): it cannot spend CP on Reactions, Counter effects or defensive sphere effects until the start of the array owner's next turn (combat/ext/formations.py row_allowed).

formation_cp_tax._rule: Formations, Suppressing Vein Pulse (successful save): the next time it spends CP before the start of the array owner's next turn it spends 1 additional CP (combat/ext/formations.py).

formation_teleport_dis._rule: Formations, Sealing Gate Pulse (successful save): Disadvantage on the next check or saving throw it makes to teleport, possess or travel spiritually, until the start of the array owner's next turn (combat/ext/formations.py).

formation_located._rule: Formations, Sensing Eye Pulse: the array's owner knows where it is, even if Invisible or Hidden, until the start of the owner's next turn (combat/senses.py pinpoints).

formation_free_step._rule: Formations, Veiled Road Pulse: on its next turn it may move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks (combat/ext/formations.py).

formation_keyed._rule: Formations, Gate Keeper: keyed to the array by its creator; ignores its Difficult Terrain and passes its boundary without its hostile boundary effects.

formation_setup._rule: Formations, the next array you set (Layered Pattern, Line Array, Gate Keeper): a second Pattern Layer (+2 CP), a line instead of a circle, creatures keyed to it. Used up when the array is set (combat/ext/formation_talents.py).

formation_exit._rule: Formations, Collapsing Exit: it may move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks; ending outside the collapsed array's former area gives it Temporary HP equal to the array owner's Proficiency Bonus (combat/ext/formation_talents.py).

formation_marked._rule: Formations, Eye of the Formation Master: while it serves as the array's auxiliary Eye the formation master is Marked -- attacks against it have Advantage if the attacker is inside the array and can see it (combat/ext/formation_masters.py).

formation_half_cover._rule: Formations, Harmonized Pulse (Veiled Road): Half Cover (+2 AC against ranged attacks) while it stays inside the array, until the start of the array owner's next turn (combat/ext/formation_masters.py).

formation_unlit._rule: Formations, Elemental Killing Array (Radiance): it gains no benefit from being Invisible or Hidden until the start of the array owner's next turn (combat/ext/formation_masters.py masked_conditions).

formation_dim._rule: Formations, Elemental Killing Array (Shadow or Dark): Disadvantage on its next Wisdom (Perception) check, until the start of the array owner's next turn.

formation_weak_con._rule: Formations, Elemental Killing Array (Blood or Poison): Disadvantage on its next Constitution saving throw, until the start of the array owner's next turn (used up by that save).

formation_spirit_locked._rule: Formations, Spirit-Lock Array: it cannot be summoned or teleported (its own teleporting, or being teleported) until the start of the array owner's next turn (combat/ext/formations.py teleport_check, combat/summons.py summon_check).

illusion_sovereign._rule: Illusion, Sovereign Illusion Incarnation: for 1 minute, two Misdirection Responses a round and Create Figment / Plant False Premise as Bonus Actions (combat/ext/illusion_riders.py).

glamer_unending._rule: Illusion, Obscuring Glamer (augment): the glamer does not end when its bearer attacks, uses a technique or deals damage (combat/ext/illusion_riders.py).

violence_word._rule: Fate, Violence Word: on its next turn its Action can only be an attack against the nearest creature; it ends once that attack is made (combat/ext/fate_riders.py).

jinxed_name._rule: Fate, Jinxed Name (failed save): once per round -1d4 on its attack roll, ability check or saving throw; it repeats the Charisma save at the end of each of its turns (combat/ext/fate_riders.py).

jinxed_once._rule: Fate, Jinxed Name (successful save): -1d4 on its next attack roll or ability check before the start of the curser's next turn (combat/ext/fate_riders.py).

chain_of_misfortune._rule: Fate, Chain of Misfortune: the first time each round it misses an attack, fails a saving throw or falls Prone, its curser picks a misfortune; it repeats the Charisma save at the end of each of its turns (combat/ext/fate_riders.py).

chain_warning._rule: Fate, Chain of Misfortune (successful save): its next missed attack or failed save before the start of the curser's next turn costs it its Reactions until the start of its following turn (combat/ext/fate_riders.py).

chain_opening._rule: Fate, Chain of Misfortune: the named ally has Advantage on its next attack roll against it before the start of the curser's next turn (combat/ext/fate_riders.py).

fate_auspice._rule: Fate, an Auspice whose Release combat plays (Guiding Star, Moving Star, Red Thread's save bonus); it ends with its caster's Concentration (combat/ext/fate_riders.py).

guiding_star_free._rule: Fate, Guiding Star Auspice released: it provokes no Opportunity Attacks for 1 minute (combat/ext/fate_riders.py).

moving_star_ignore._rule: Fate, Moving Star Auspice released: it ignores the named condition until the end of its next turn (combat/ext/fate_riders.py).

turning_wheel._rule: Fate, Turning Wheel Auspice: +1 (+2 at CL 11, +3 at CL 17) to what the 1d6 gave -- attack and damage rolls, saving throws or ability checks (combat/ext/fate_riders.py).

fate_sovereign._rule: Fate, Fate-Sovereign Incarnation: its Fate Die is at least a d10, and at the start of each of its turns an ally within 30 feet gains a boon (combat/ext/fate_riders.py).

sovereign_boon._rule: Fate, Fate-Sovereign Incarnation's boon: +1 AC, +1 to saving throws or Advantage on its next attack roll, until the start of the Sovereign's next turn (combat/ext/fate_riders.py).

calamity._rule: Fate, Calamity Finds a Path: the chosen misfortunes (Speed 0, AC -2, healing halved) until the start of the caster's next turn (combat/ext/fate_riders.py).

lock_grip._rule: Ice, Lock Grip: Disadvantage on its next attack roll with its weapon until the start of its next turn (combat/ext/ice_fracture.py).

mirror_slick_immune._rule: Ice, Mirror-Slick Floor: immune to that Ice cultivator's Mirror-Slick Floor until the start of its next turn (combat/ext/ice_fracture.py).

bitter_edge._rule: Ice, Bitter Edge: its first weapon or unarmed hit each of its turns deals PB extra Cold damage (and a Fracture Mark on the Ice cultivator's lattice) (combat/ext/ice_fracture.py).

frost_guard._rule: Ice, Frost-Sheathed Guard: the first creature to hit it in melee while its Temporary HP last gains a Fracture Mark (combat/ext/ice_fracture.py).

diamond_rime._rule: Ice, Diamond Rime Body: a creature that hits it in melee gets a Lattice Space under it (combat/ext/ice_fracture.py).

winter_crucible._rule: Ice, Immortal Winter Crucible: one more Lattice Space each time it creates them; a Fracture Mark spent on its own turn does not count against the round's limit (combat/ext/ice_fracture.py).

digestive_mantle._rule: Hunger, Digestive Mantle: the chosen basic benefit's triggered parts (Beast Strength, Predator Step, Iron Stomach, Thick Hide, Venom Belly, Furnace Belly) for the Mantle's minute (combat/ext/hunger_riders.py).

karma_chain._rule: Karma, Chain of Consequence: the next damage it deals returns to it as Psychic damage (combat/ext/karma_riders.py).

karma_burden._rule: Burden of Deeds: chosen penalties; repeat the Charisma save at each turn end to end them. Concentration, up to 1 minute.

karma_burden_check._rule: Burden of Deeds: Disadvantage on one ability check before the affected creature's next turn ends.

karma_ten_thousand._rule: Karma, Ten Thousand Debts: the first harm it deals returns to it (combat/ext/karma_riders.py).

karma_trial._rule: Karma, Trial of the Ledger: its first harm each turn costs 2d8 Psychic; its first heal gives 2d8 Temporary HP (combat/ext/karma_riders.py).

karma_trial_once._rule: Karma, Trial of the Ledger: its first harm costs Psychic damage (combat/ext/karma_riders.py).

karma_writ._rule: Karma, Judgment Writ: its first harm each turn costs Psychic damage (combat/ext/karma_riders.py).

karma_bone._rule: Karma, Debt Written on Bone: its next damage brings the chosen consequence (combat/ext/karma_riders.py).

karma_merit._rule: Karma, Merit Becomes Armor: healing another gives it Temporary HP once a round (combat/ext/karma_riders.py).

karma_sovereign._rule: Karma, Karma-Sovereign Incarnation: Record the Deed reaches 300 feet (combat/ext/karma_riders.py).

glass_tempered._rule: Glass: a tempered Glass Surface (its body, armor or held weapon) for its Faultline Marks and Refraction Responses (combat/ext/glass_refraction.py).

glass_incarnation._rule: Glass, Incarnation of the Transparent Fault: always tempered; a free Refraction Response each round (combat/ext/glass_refraction.py).

glass_lens._rule: Glass, Lens of the Honest Crack: its first attack roll or technique gives it a Faultline Mark (combat/ext/glass_refraction.py).

glass_stored._rule: Glass, Lens of Stored Pressure: its next Faultline Strike or Glass Shard hit adds damage (combat/ext/glass_refraction.py).

glass_spared._rule: Glass, Living Pane Sutra: used this fight (combat/ext/glass_refraction.py).

glass_revealed._rule: Glass, Visible Crack: its space is known until the start of the Glass cultivator's next turn (combat/ext/glass_refraction.py).

speech_damaged._rule: Retribution, Haymaker: its speech and breath channel is damaged -- an ability that needs its voice calls for a Constitution save or fails (combat/ext/retribution_riders.py).

conditioned._rule: Retribution, Intense Conditioning: the same category of action (an attack roll or a technique) calls for a Charisma save or fails (combat/ext/retribution_riders.py).

dug_in._rule: Retribution, Dug-In Blow: Resistance to the named creature's next Bludgeoning, Piercing or Slashing hit (combat/ext/retribution_riders.py).

deep_root._rule: Earth, Deep Root Stance: its space is a Foundation Space; forced movement on it is shorter; a melee miss marks the attacker (combat/ext/earth_responses.py).

patient_mountain._rule: Earth, Incarnation of the Patient Mountain: Foundation Spaces within 10 feet of it (combat/ext/earth_responses.py).

sinking_dex._rule: Earth, Sinking Foot Rebuke: Disadvantage on its next Dexterity saving throw (combat/ext/earth_responses.py).

shield_broken._rule: Shield, Sacrificial Shield: the Shield broke to turn a Critical Hit into a normal hit -- no Shield Bonus (-2 AC) for the rest of the fight (combat/ext/shield_riders.py).

extensive_defense._rule: Shield, Extensive Defense: until the start of its next turn every attack against it (and, with Cover Ally, allies within 5 feet) meets Active Defense's +2 AC without a Reaction (combat/ext/shield_riders.py).

second_answer._rule: Shield, Shield of the Second Answer: the next attack against it before the start of the shield-bearer's next turn meets Active Defense's +2 AC without a Reaction (combat/ext/shield_riders.py).

rooted_rim._rule: Shield, Mountain-Rooted Rim: forced movement on it is 10 feet shorter until the start of the shield-bearer's next turn; Advantage on a save against Prone from the triggering attack or effect (combat/ext/shield_riders.py).

glamer_muffled._rule: Illusion, Obscuring Glamer (Muffle augment): Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) to find it by hearing; heavy armor gives no Stealth Disadvantage (combat/ext/illusion_riders.py).

no_bonus_actions._rule: It cannot take Bonus Actions (Jester: Absurd Agreement, The Whole Court Laughs, Ten-Thousand Masks Procession; combat/ext/no_bonus_actions.py candidate_allowed).

formation_maze_lost._rule: Formations, Formation Maze (failed save): until the start of the array owner's next turn it cannot willingly move closer to the keyed ally, Array Eye or Node the owner chose (combat/ext/formation_riders.py candidate_allowed).

formation_maze_slowed._rule: Formations, Formation Maze (successful save): its next 10 feet of movement inside the array cost 10 additional feet (combat/ext/formation_riders.py).

foundations1_wind_body_step._rule: Wind-Body Step (Dragon-Wind Vessel): Advantage on your next Athletics or Acrobatics check before the end of your turn -- to keep your footing, pass through a creature's space, avoid being knocked down, resist being moved, or keep your movement legal. The first such check spends it.

shadow_outlives_resistance._rule: Shadow That Outlives the Body: after spending your Reaction and 15 CP (your cultivation resource points), you take half damage from Acid, Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Piercing, Poison, Psychic, Slashing and Thunder until the end of your next turn. Radiant, Force and Void damage are not resisted.

void_prison._rule: Void Prison (Sphere of Void): a visible cage of absence holds the creature in its space. It cannot willingly leave (its Speed is 0 while the prison lasts), and teleporting needs a Cultivation Check against the caster's save DC first (combat/ext/void_riders.py). Attacks and effects pass through the cage normally. The cage is an object (AC 15, Hit Points 10 times the caster's Proficiency Bonus) the GM tracks; destroying it ends the prison.

turbulent._rule: Turbulent (Qiweaving Turbulent Field, combat/ext/qi_instability.py): the marker of a technique that suffered the Field's complication -- the GM picks it, the engine adds no penalty of its own (owner text: 'should not normally waste the technique'). Lasts until the end of the Field owner's next turn so Regulated Breathing (repeat the save) and Calm the Wild Meridian (suppress it) have something to act on.

mark_durations._rule: Puppetry core rules (Tension Marks): "A Tension Mark lasts until the end of your next turn." (placed-effects 2026-09-29). Thread core rules (Thread Lines): "The line lasts until the end of your next turn." (riders lane 4, 2026-09-29); Ice, Glass, and Earth mark durations (rider lane 9)

mark_families._rule: Yang (Sphere Compendium, Mark Limit): "You can maintain a number of Rising Marks equal to your Proficiency Bonus. A creature, object, or ongoing effect can have only one Rising Mark from you at a time." A Kindled Mark and an Overkindled Mark are both Rising Marks: they share the limit and a subject carries one of them from you (riders lane 2, 2026-09-29; combat/typed_executor.py block_mark).

duration_rounds._rule: Counted durations: 1 round is one full round, 1 minute is 10 rounds, 1 hour is 600 rounds and 1 day is 14400 rounds. Effects, marks and zones share this table and the removable round clock. Only the explicit scene kinds in lasts_the_fight last the whole fight. A Concentration technique's own effects stay on CONCENTRATION_END whatever their length. Effect-level 'one_round' is left out on purpose: the typing uses it for 'once per round' limits as well as durations.
